4943603.name: Chabad of S. Lake County
4943603.note: CrownHeights.info, 9 March 2021: 'Lake County, FL welcomed its first Shluchim, Rabbi Moshe, Chavi and baby Mendel Dubinsky under the auspices of Rabbi Shalom Ber Dubov'. IRS: 'Chabad Of South Lake County Inc', exempt from Jan 2022.

6426867.name: Chabad of San Marco and Greater Downtown
6426867.note: CrownHeights.info, 21 May 2024: 'Rabbi Kalman and Miri Ezagui ... have been appointed by Rabbi Yosef and Rivkie Kahanov as Shluchim to Downtown Jacksonville, FL'. IRS: 'Chabad Downtown Jacksonville', exempt from April 2025.

5749831.name: Chabad of Oviedo-Winter Springs
5749831.note: COLlive, 24 July 2020: Rabbi Tzviky and Fraidy Dubov 'have moved to Orlando' as Chabad of Greater Orlando's 'newest Shluchim to work with the Maitland, Winter Park, Casselberry, Oviedo, Winter Springs and Orlando areas'. IRS: 'Chabad Of Oviedo-Winter Springs Inc', exempt from Aug 2023, so the center of its own existed by then. When it became a center of its own is not found; lead: the chabad.org listing is from about 2023.

7229313.name: Oakland Park Chabad
7229313.note: COLlive announced the new shluchim on 24 March 2026; CrownHeights.info, 16 April 2026: 'the city of Oakland Park is now seeing a Jewish revival with the arrival of Rabbi Sruli and Faigy Mochkin'; they first came for Rosh Hashanah (2025) in a rented clubhouse, returned for Chanukah and Purim, then moved.

436834.name: Chabad at UCF
436834.note: Chabad.edu (CrownHeights.info, 15 May 2007), on Rabbi Chaim and Rivkie Lipskier, co-directors of 'the new Chabad house at the University of Central Florida': 'Chabad opened its doors at the end of this school year's fall semester' (Dec 2006); the first Shabbat dinner drew 12 students. Heritage (Jan 2016): a permanent home near campus 'after nine years'; a new student center opened in 2023.

earlier.where: Orlando: the Lipskiers' 3,000-square-foot home, about five miles from campus (Shabbat for 100-200 students)

589520.name: Chabad of Royal Palm Beach
589520.note: Town-Crier (22 Nov 2013): 'Chabad of Royal Palm Beach has been in existence for about six years' (count back: about 2007); Rabbi Nachman Zeev Schtroks came at the suggestion of his uncle Rabbi Mendy Muskal (Wellington); it started with monthly lunch-and-learns before it had a location, ran from an office at 11440 Okeechobee Blvd. for several years, and in 2013 took over the former Temple Beth Zion, 129 Sparrow Drive.

577190.name: Chabad Jewish Centre at Wiregrass
577190.note: Laker/Lutz News: Rabbi Mendy and Chanie Yarmush 'moved to the area a couple of years ago'; 'Our first event was Hannukah, in December 2008', at the Shops at Wiregrass, with over 300 people. First called Chabad at County Line; its synagogue at 2124 Ashley Oaks Circle (Seven Oaks Professional Center) opened on Sept. 11 of a later year.

earlier.where: the Yarmushes' home in Wesley Chapel (as Chabad at County Line)

577765.name: Chabad Chai - South Tampa
577765.note: Its own site ('Our Story'): 'Chabad Chai - South Tampa was established in 2008 to serve the Jewish community of South Tampa.' Rabbi Mendy and Nechama Dina Dubrowski (he grew up in Tampa, son of Rabbi Yossie Dubrowski of Chabad of Tampa Bay).

581876.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of S. Augustine
581876.note: First Coast Chabad blog (8 April 2011): 'Rabbi Levi and his wife, Fraidy, moved to St. Augustine in October of 2007 to establish the Chabad Center for Jewish Life.' St. Augustine Record (CrownHeights.info, 19 Feb 2008): 'The worldwide Chabad Lubavitch movement has organized a new center in St. Augustine'; Rabbi Levi Vogel 'recently moved from Brooklyn'.

682678.name: Chabad of Cutler Bay & Homestead
682678.note: Miami Herald (CrownHeights.info, 20 Dec 2010): 'The chabad was established in August 2008 in Wolff's living room, and in September 2010 it moved to a shopping center on Old Cutler Road' (Rabbi Yossi and Mindy Wolff).

earlier.where: a shopping center on Old Cutler Road

823538.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of North Orlando
823538.note: Orlando Judaism Examiner (CrownHeights.info, 21 July 2009): 'Rabbi Yanky Majesky and his wife, Chanshy, as well as their daughter Chayale, have just moved from Brooklyn, NY to lay the groundwork for a vibrant Jewish community in North Orlando' (Lake Mary, Sanford, Longwood). First services: Rosh Hashanah at the Courtyard Marriott, Lake Mary; Nate's Shul, 1701 Markham Woods Road, dedicated 2016. (A 2013 proclamation says 'since 2010'.)

earlier.where: Courtyard Marriott, Lake Mary (first High Holiday services)

117942.name: The Shul of Downtown
117942.note: Chabad.org (20 Feb 2014, the grand opening of the new center): the downtown shul was 'founded by The Shul of Bal Harbour under the leadership of Rabbi Sholom Lipskar, who started it nearly 30 years ago' (count back: about 1985); 'About 10 years ago, Rabbi Chaim and Deenie Lipskar took it over'; for the previous seven years it was 'situated in a 2,000-square-foot space on the sixth floor of an office tower'. Now the Rok Family Shul, Chabad Downtown Jewish Center.

earlier.where: a 2,000-square-foot space on the sixth floor of a downtown office tower
